defs.def: that can be done or achieved 可能；能做到（或取得）

ex.s: “It’s possible to open that lock with another key,” I said.
ex.t: “用另一把钥匙也有可能打开那把锁，”我说。

ex.s: Eat with others whenever possible.
ex.t: 尽可能与人共餐。

ex.s: If you take an online course, what can you do to ensure the best possible grade?
ex.t: 如果你修一门在线课程，你能做些什么来确保取得尽可能好的成绩？

ex.s: It’s good to eat things at the correct time, when they’re ___38___, and as close as possible to where they were ___39___.
ex.t: 在合适的时间、在食物___38___的时候，并且尽可能靠近它们被___39___的地方吃，是件好事。

ex.s: Here is some advice on how to make a trip by rail as pleasant as possible.
ex.t: 这里有一些关于如何让铁路旅行尽可能愉快的建议。

ex.s: What makes the application of drones to rail lines possible?
ex.t: 是什么让无人机应用于铁路线路成为可能？

ex.s: On a website called No Fly Climate Sci, for example, _____40_____（rough） 200 academics - many of them climate scientists ____41____ （promise） to fly as little as possible since the effort started two years ago.
ex.t: 例如，在一个名为No Fly Climate Sci的网站上，（第40空，rough）200名学者——其中许多是气候科学家——自两年前该行动开始以来（第41空，promise）尽可能少飞。

ex.s: My perfectionist tendencies were the main root of this: I wanted to be perfect at whatever I did, which obviously in life is not possible, but it consumed me.
ex.t: 我的完美主义倾向是主要原因：我想在所做的任何事情上都做到完美，这在生活中显然是不可能的，但它吞噬了我。

ex.s: A possible reason for the study findings.
ex.t: 研究结果的一个可能原因。

ex.s: In-depth exploration makes discoveries possible.
ex.t: 深入探索使发现成为可能。

ex.s: The Possible and the Impossible .
ex.t: 可能与不可能

ex.s: 35 People give them money to do this and all the money helps get clean water to as many people as possible around the world.
ex.t: 35 人们给他们钱来做这件事，而所有的钱都帮助全世界尽可能多的人获得洁净的饮用水。

ex.s: Oliver says if you're   2   (luck) enough to have someone close to you who enjoys cooking, ask them   3   you can join in when it's possible.
ex.t: 奥利弗说,如果你2(幸运)足够有 与你亲近的人谁喜欢做饭, 问他们3,你可以加入 当有可能。

ex.s: We house a broad range of experts united by the common goal of creating the best language learning tools possible.
ex.t: 我们汇聚了众多专家，他们因创造尽可能好的语言学习工具这一共同目标而团结在一起。

ex.s: Since the early days of AI, imagination has outpaced what is possible or even probable.
ex.t: 从人工智能早期开始，想象力就一直超越可能甚至可行的范围。

ex.s: What makes the invention of the smart keyboard possible？
ex.t: 是什么使智能键盘的发明成为可能？

ex.s: It’s possible that we all have compromised conversational intelligence.
ex.t: 可能是我们所有人的对话智力都受到了影响。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: Use your own words as far as possible.
ex.t: 快进到现在，经济还没有完全恢复。

ex.s: For Mr Smith, this is a possible life-changing    35   .
ex.t: 对史密斯先生来说，这可能是改变人生的___35___。

ex.s: This development was only possible with the ___69___ (introduce) of electric-powered engines and lifts.
ex.t: 这一发展只有在____69___（引进）电力发动机和电梯之后才成为可能。

ex.s: This development was only possible with the ___69___ (introduce) of electric-powered engines and lifts.
ex.t: 这一发展只有在____69___（引进）电力发动机和电梯之后才成为可能。

ex.s: Some argue that humans and machines can coexist as long as they work in teams—yet that is not possible unless machines share the goals of humans.
ex.t: 有人认为人类和机器可以共存，只要他们团队合作——但除非机器分享人类的目标，否则这是不可能的。

ex.s: Just keep an open mind and take part in as much as possible.
ex.t: 只要保持开放的心态，尽可能地多参与。

ex.s: Therefore, the key is to keep your shower times as short as possible.
ex.t: 因此，关键是要尽可能缩短淋浴时间。

ex.s: Whether you paint still lifes, portraits, or landscapes, paint from life as much as possible. ___37___
ex.t: 无论你画静物、肖像还是风景，都要尽可能多地写生。___37___

ex.s: Solar developers want to put up panels as quickly and cheaply as possible, so they haven’t given much thought to what they put under them.
ex.t: 太阳能开发商希望尽可能快速廉价地安装电池板，所以他们没有过多考虑电池板下面放置什么。

ex.s: Like anything, it is possible to have too much of both,     70    is not good for the health.
ex.t: 像任何事情一样，两者都可能过量，这对健康____是不好的。

ex.s: I gave the owner as much information as possible and headed home to see what news the night might bring.
ex.t: 我向主人尽可能多地提供了信息，然后朝家走去，看看那个夜晚会带来什么消息。

ex.s: Finally, I conducted an elegant experiment that would not have been possible without the help of the members in the lab.
ex.t: 最终，我进行了一项精巧的实验，若没有实验室成员们的帮助，这项实验是不可能完成的。

ex.s: Because the number of possible topics____43____（be）practically limitless, we focus on a sample of the most interesting and useful applications and tools and explain the basic principles of technology.
ex.t: 因为可能的主题数量___43___（be）几乎无穷无尽，我们聚焦于最有趣、最有用的应用和工具的一个样本，并解释技术的基本原理。

ex.s: After you hear a conversation and the question about it, read the four possible answers on your paper, and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
ex.t: 听完对话及问题后，在纸上阅读四个可能答案，决定哪一个是你所听到问题的最佳答案。

ex.s: When you hear a question, read the four possible answers on your paper and decide which one is the best answer to the question you have heard.
ex.t: 听到问题时，在纸上阅读四个可能答案，决定哪一个是你所听到问题的最佳答案。

defs.def: that might exist or happen but is not certain to 可能存在（或发生）的

ex.s: Possible direction for further study.
ex.t: 成功的感觉不再与我获得的分数挂钩，而是与学习的纯粹快乐相连。

ex.s: To indicate a possible danger of cloud seeding.
ex.t: 为了说明人工降雨可能存在的危险。

ex.s: He has helped me see not only more ____56____ ideas than I thought possible, but who I can be.
ex.t: 他帮助我不仅看到了比我想象中的更多的——56——想法,而且我能够成为什么样的人.

ex.s: Rereading makes it possible for us to see the world around us, ourselves included, in a new light.
ex.t: 重读使我们能够以一种新的眼光看待我们周围的世界，包括我们自己。

ex.s: It is possible  ___43___ (walk) or bike the entire 14 kilometers.
ex.t: 可以步行或骑自行车走完整个14公里的路程。

ex.s: Anything was possible.
ex.t: 在Juan的世界里，每个村庄都可以有自己的月亮。

ex.s: They should look at making themselves as attractive as possible to employers.
ex.t: 作为在信息时代成长起来的一代，他们在展示自己在这方面的兴趣和技能时相当自信。

ex.s: And sometimes a word is made up of the first letters of several words: “World Trade Organization” can be referred to as 8________, and 9_________ is short for “as soon as possible”.
ex.t: 有时,一个词由几个词的第一个字母组成:“世界贸易组织”可以称为8        ,9         简称“尽快”。

ex.s: People were excited – the zoo is the only place in the country where it is possible to see pandas.
ex.t: 人们很兴奋——动物园是这个国家唯一能看到熊猫的地方。

ex.s: But through repetition, it’s possible to form new habits.
ex.t: 但通过重复，有可能形成新的习惯。

ex.s: But as the 200th anniversary of his birth approaches, it is possible — and important for our own culture—to understand how he made himself a lasting one.
ex.t: 但随着他诞辰200周年临近，去理解他如何让自己成为不朽作家，不仅是可能的，也对我们自身的文化十分重要。

ex.s: Solving the safety problem well enough to move forward in AI seems to be possible but not easy.
ex.t: 有特定用途的机器之所以与生物有关联，部分原因是因为它们可能能够        .

ex.s: Explain the possible problems with their lifestyles.
ex.t: 解释他们生活方式中可能存在的问题。

ex.s: Although technology might make day-to-day communication possible, extra effort goes a long way on special days.
ex.t: 尽管科技或许能让日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子里，额外的努力作用很大。
